characters.continuity: Avatar: The Last Airbender Animated Series
characters.summary: Aang is an Air Nomad monk and the Avatar, capable of bending all four elements: air, water, earth, and fire. He prefers evasive, agile combat maneuvers based on redirection and non-lethal defense rather than direct aggression.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to sudden physical attacks when caught off guard
Initial reluctance to use lethal force or firebending
limitations: Requires access to the respective physical element (air, water, earth, fire) to bend effectively

sources.supports: Summary of Aang's bending abilities, background as an Air Nomad, and general combat style.

feats.claim: Used airbending to create an air scooter for fast movement and evasion

notableResults.note: Defeated Zuko using defensive evasion and environment.

campaignTags.claim: Glider staff allows Aang to glide through the air

unknowns: Exact limits of elemental stamina without rest

characters.continuity: Avatar: The Last Airbender Animated Series
characters.summary: In the Avatar State, Aang channels the combined knowledge, power, and skill of all past Avatars, granting him overwhelming elemental control and flight.
weaknesses: Vulnerable if struck and killed while in the Avatar State, which would end the cycle
limitations: Triggered involuntarily under extreme stress early in mastery
Risk of cycle termination if killed in this state
characters.formDifferences: Unlocks vast cosmic power, automatic mastery of all elements simultaneously, levitation, and extreme destructive capacity compared to base Aang.

sources.supports: Avatar State mechanics and power amplification.

notableResults.citation: Avatar: The Last Airbender season 3 finale
notableResults.note: Used the Avatar State to overpower Phoenix King Ozai and strip his bending.

conditional.dependsOn: Extreme emotional stress or conscious unlocking of past lives

campaignTags.claim: Levitation and flight powered by elemental air streams in the Avatar State
Mastery over water bending in the Avatar State
Mastery over fire bending in the Avatar State

unknowns: Full extent of past lives' knowledge accessible during combat

characters.summary: Aladdin is a resourceful street rat who relies on agility, quick thinking, improvised tools, and occasionally the wish-granting powers of the Genie to overcome adversaries.
weaknesses: Physically ordinary human without magical assistance or items
limitations: Relies heavily on environment and external items (like the Magic Carpet or Genie) against superhuman threats

sources.supports: Aladdin's skills, abilities, and reliance on wit and agility.

feats.claim: Evaded Agrabah guards using parkour and urban acrobatics

notableResults.note: Defeated Jafar by exploiting his desire for absolute power, tricking him into becoming a genie.

unknowns: Combat effectiveness without any tools or urban environment

characters.summary: Anna is an optimistic and fiercely determined princess of Arendelle who relies on physical resilience, close-quarters improvised combat, and sheer perseverance.
weaknesses: Lacks supernatural powers or formal combat training

sources.supports: Anna's personality, feats of endurance, and physical style.

feats.claim: Struck Kristoff and various obstacles with physical force and survived extreme cold

notableResults.note: Punched Prince Hans overboard after enduring a frozen curse.

unknowns: Combat capabilities in structured martial combat

characters.continuity: Disney's The Little Mermaid Animated Film
characters.summary: Ariel is a mermaid princess who possesses aquatic agility and a siren-like singing voice capable of captivating listeners.
weaknesses: Cannot breathe air naturally without transformation; immobile on land in mermaid form
limitations: Helpless on dry land without legs

sources.supports: Ariel's aquatic abilities and mermaid physiology.

feats.claim: Swam rapidly through ocean currents and explored sunken shipwrecks

notableResults.note: Assisted in ramming Ursula with a shipwreck helm.

campaignTags.claim: Mermaid physiology adapted for underwater life

unknowns: Combat effectiveness against land-based opponents without water access

characters.continuity: Disney's The Jungle Book Animated Film
characters.summary: Baloo is a large, carefree sloth bear who uses his immense natural physical strength, weight, and heavy swipes in brawls.
weaknesses: Lazy, easily distracted, lacks tactical discipline
limitations: Low speed and agility compared to agile predators

sources.supports: Baloo's bear characteristics, strength, and personality.

feats.claim: Fought off a pack of wolves and wrestled Shere Khan

notableResults.note: Intervened to protect Mowgli, engaging the tiger in a physical struggle.

characters.summary: Bandit Heeler is an adult Australian Red Heeler dog who mostly engages in imaginative play, rough-and-tumble parenting games, and domestic tasks.
weaknesses: Not a combatant; regular domestic dog in a cartoon setting
limitations: No combat training or offensive weapons

sources.supports: Bandit's role as a father engaged in domestic play.

feats.claim: Endured extensive physical exhaustion from playing complex games with his children

unknowns: Any actual combat feats outside of domestic play

characters.summary: Barney Rubble is a stone-age caveman who relies on primitive brute strength, clubs, and cartoonish durability in comedic scuffles.
weaknesses: Easily startled, relies on primitive technology
limitations: Restricted to stone-age tools and physical brawling

sources.supports: Barney Rubble's background and setting in The Flintstones.

feats.claim: Lifted heavy stone appliances and participated in prehistoric sports

characters.summary: Bart Simpson is a ten-year-old prankster who utilizes a slingshot, skateboards, stealthy traps, and mischief to outmaneuver opponents.
weaknesses: Physically weak compared to adults; easily caught if cornered

sources.supports: Bart's signature slingshot use, skateboard mobility, and prankster persona.

feats.claim: Hit multiple targets accurately at a distance using a slingshot

campaignTags.claim: Uses a slingshot and prank items

unknowns: Effectiveness in direct hand-to-hand combat against trained fighters

characters.summary: Dr. Henry 'Hank' McCoy (Beast) combines superhuman agility, acrobatic combat, superhuman strength, and a brilliant scientific intellect.
weaknesses: Susceptible to high-voltage energy dampening and specialized mutant-inhibiting tech
limitations: Physical size makes complete stealth difficult

sources.supports: Beast's superhuman physical traits, agility, intellect, and combat style.

feats.claim: Lifted heavy machinery and fought trained combatants using prehensile feet and hands

notableResults.note: Overwhelmed by superior numbers of mutant-hunting Sentinel robots.

campaignTags.claim: Genius scientist who creates advanced technology
Utilizes advanced tech equipment and laboratory devices

unknowns: Limits of his mutation under prolonged extreme environments
